title: development-flow agent contract
description: Tells the development-flow skills and hooks how this repository is verified, run and documented. Lives at .agents/contract.json.

version.description: Contract format version. Bumped only on breaking changes; onboard migrates older contracts.

verify.description: Shell commands, run from the repository root. Each must exit 0 when the change is good.

fast.description: Seconds-range check run after edits and on Stop, e.g. type-check plus lint.

full.description: Everything CI checks before merge. pull-request requires a green run of this on the current commit.

e2e.description: End-to-end suite over the critical flows. Optional while the repo has none.

run.description: How an agent starts the app to look at a change.

dev.description: Starts the app. Prefer a mode that needs no real backend or credentials.

mocked.description: true when run.dev works without a real backend or secrets.

login.description: Path to a doc that explains how an agent signs in to the running app.

docs.description: Repository-relative paths to the domain knowledge agents must read.

glossary.description: Ubiquitous-language glossary, usually GLOSSARY.md (older repos: CONTEXT.md).

prd.description: Directory where distill writes product requirement documents.

tracker.description: Where work items live. distill writes there; implement reads from there.

project.description: Project key or board identifier, e.g. a Jira key.

skill.description: Repository skill that knows the tracker's fields and templates. When set, distill delegates ticket creation to it.

path.description: For kind local: directory holding one folder per feature with spec.md and issues/NN-slug.md files. Usually .scratch.

review.description: Repository skills that review adds to its generic pass.

template.description: Path to the pull request body template.

evidence.description: Command that uploads screenshots and prints markdown to embed.
